statement: Create a program that prints '6' and exits with code 7.
solution:
section .data
    msg db '6', 10
    len equ $ - msg

section .text
    global _start

_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, msg
    mov rdx, len
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    mov rdi, 7
    syscall
